action_requested: Create orchestrator dead-file identification and cleanup script

context.goal: services/orchestrator/ currently has 7083 files (verified via find). The previous audit task (task_001) identified the problem but no cleanup script was produced. Create a Python script at scripts/orchestrator-cleanup.py that: (1) scans services/orchestrator/ and categorizes files into: build artifacts (target/, node_modules/, __pycache__/, dist/, .next/), test stubs (<1KB .test.* files), duplicate patterns (files with identical content hashes), and potentially-dead files (not imported by any other file in the directory), (2) outputs a JSON report to scripts/orchestrator-cleanup-report.json with categories and file counts, (3) includes a --dry-run flag (DEFAULT) that only generates the report, and a --execute flag that moves dead files to .trash/orchestrator-cleanup/ (never deletes — always moves to trash for rollback). The script must NOT delete or move anything in dry-run mode. Run it in dry-run mode to generate the initial report. Do NOT run with --execute.
constraints: dry-run mode ONLY — do not use --execute flag
never delete files — move to .trash/ for rollback
deliverables: Script defaults to --dry-run, requires explicit --execute to move files
